# address: # Names applied to the 1.2.0 Ghidra program by ApplyNames.java. "_q" suffix = best guess.

name: Reset_Handler
note: MCUXpresso startup: FlexRAM config, data/bss tables, stack fill, libc init, main

name: fw_request_update
note: writes ptf name to /Firmware/_fwinfo, "start" to /Firmware/_turnon, resets

name: song_grid_draw
note: song screen: 16 x 12 grid of track blocks; filled color = theme+0x04 or +0x1c, empty = +0x20

name: song_grid_track_selection
note: tracks bounding box of the selected cells

name: song_ctrl_draw_grid
note: vtable 0x60046c80 slot; calls song_grid_draw then song_grid_overlay_q

name: scr_song_set_grid_data
note: fills screen+0xcc grid data (slots, masks, track flags) and calls disp_ctrl_set_data

name: pattern_update_track_usage
note: (ctx, patternNo 1-based, patternData): sets project lo/hi track-used bits; returns changed

name: crt_frame_dummy_q
note: GCC crtstuff; carries the image-end symbol 0x601bab78

name: BOARD_ConfigMPU
note: MPU regions; 0x20280000 falls in region 4 (RW, Device)

name: scr_song_start
note: Song screen entry: usage_current, then bl scr_song_set_grid_data at 0x600fe402

name: pattern_read_file
note: open(path, mode 0) / read 0x3030 / close via FS vtable

name: fs_open
note: +0x2c: (res{handle,ok}, fs, path, mode, x); allocates a 0x104 handle

name: fs_read
note: +0x30: (fs, buf, size, handle) -> bytes read or -1 (FatFs f_read)

name: fatfs_f_read
note: direct disk_read into caller buffer for >=512 at sector boundary, else via FIL+0x50

name: sd_read_blocks
note: NXP SD_ReadBlocks: card lock (infinite wait), bounce buffer for unaligned
